1_download_mako_renderer_v_version_flatp: 1. Download MAKO-Renderer-v<version>-flatpaks.tar.xz from the release below, matching the version selected in PeliGames. Extract it and open a terminal in that folder.
2_close_the_launcher_and_its_games_these: 2. Close the launcher and its games. These commands install the runtime extension and grant access only to profiles and the DLL folder. Review before running; PeliGames does not change permissions automatically.
3_verify_setup_then_enable_this_game_and: 3. Verify setup, then enable this game and save. Steam Flatpak still needs the per-game launch command; the native package alone does not enable the extension.
saving_a_profile_alone_does_not_activate: Saving a profile alone does not activate MAKO. The next launch must use the command below.
removing_mako_also_requires_updating_ste: Removing MAKO also requires updating Steam launch options.
steam_game_properties_general_launch_opt: Steam → game Properties → General → Launch Options. You can paste the line while Steam is open, then restart the game. Automatic application through PeliGames uses Restart Steam and apply.
add_this_command_once_the_helper_reads_y: Add this command once. The helper reads your latest profile whenever the game starts, without restarting Steam. Enabling or changing the component requires restarting the game; multiplier, flow scale and lighter-model changes use MAKO's live reload. Preserve additional arguments.
